verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents a buy-rate pricing model where the platform controls what it bills merchants. Billing Profiles set per-merchant fees and rates, which covers markup and per-seller pricing. Amount splits on payins are documented but not explicitly tied to a platform fee. Missing for 10: documented reporting of platform payments revenue separate from processing costs, explicit per-transaction application-fee mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, payments are a revenue line — take an application fee or markup on every transaction, set per-seller pricing, and see my payments revenue reported distinctly from processing costs

citations.quote: You totally control how much you bill your merchants. And with our buy-rate model, any optimization to pricing or interchange costs goes directly to your bottom line.
Every merchant is assigned a Billing Profile to determine the fees and rates that are billed to the merchant.
We lead with a buy-rate, interchange-plus pricing model, and have no revenue split.
Configure the payin to apply the amount splits
